features.name: ai_complexity_score
features.description: Sum of positive indicators for various AI and machine learning mentions, creating a dense magnitude feature for distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous scale of AI involvement, improving neighborhood resolution for trials with similar technological depth.
features.formula: np.maximum(0, mentions_algorithm) + np.maximum(0, mentions_machine_learning) + np.maximum(0, mentions_deep_learning) + np.maximum(0, mentions_ai)

features.name: trial_rigor_index
features.description: Composite score of trial design rigor, combining randomization, blinding, and evidence strength.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups trials with similar methodological quality, which is a strong structural determinant in clinical trial spaces.

features.name: global_reach_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance from an unsupervised prototype representing a highly international trial (8 countries, international flag set).
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms sparse geographic indicators into a continuous distance metric, ideal for KNN geometry.

features.name: tech_deployment_similarity
features.description: Inverse distance similarity to an unsupervised prototype with maximum real-world deployment and software mentions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a bounded similarity score that pulls together trials focused on deployed software solutions.

features.name: patient_diversity_indicator
features.description: Sum of demographic inclusion flags (children, older adults, all sexes) to measure population breadth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps KNN identify clusters of trials with similar target demographic profiles.

features.name: academic_gov_collaboration_dist
features.description: Distance from an unsupervised prototype representing a fully academic and government-sponsored trial.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates trials based on their proximity to non-commercial funding structures in the feature space.

features.name: phase_enrollment_scale
features.description: Normalized additive scale combining trial phase and enrollment size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a unified scale for trial maturity and size, preventing larger raw values from dominating distance metrics.

features.name: ai_safety_privacy_focus
features.description: Sum of mentions related to ethical and safe AI use (safety, privacy, bias).
features.expected_model_benefit: Clusters trials that explicitly address AI risks, adding a thematic dimension to the distance calculation.
features.formula: np.maximum(0, mentions_safety) + np.maximum(0, mentions_privacy) + np.maximum(0, mentions_bias)

features.name: digital_health_device_proximity
features.description: Distance to an unsupervised prototype representing a trial utilizing both wearables and mobile apps.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups trials by their reliance on patient-facing digital health hardware/software.

features.name: semantic_innovation_cluster
features.description: Semantic assessment of whether the trial belongs to a highly innovative AI cluster, based on the intersection of disease area, AI use type, and deep learning mentions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Injects domain knowledge about what constitutes innovative combinations, creating a dense cluster center for KNN.

features.name: semantic_regulatory_readiness
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the trial's readiness for regulatory scrutiny, synthesizing evidence strength, safety/privacy mentions, and trial phase.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous semantic axis that aligns trials by their maturity and compliance focus, improving neighborhood relevance.

features.name: semantic_operational_complexity
features.description: Semantic judgment of the trial's operational complexity, considering international footprint, enrollment size, blinding, and randomization requirements.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a scaling factor in distance calculations, ensuring trials with vastly different logistical burdens are separated.
